commitments.detail: Regular monitoring of the patient's response to Lunacavir will be conducted by the Infectious Disease Department.
The Utilization Review Team will review the appropriateness of Lunacavir use within 48 hours of authorization.
The Outpatient Pharmacy will be notified to prepare for dispensing Lunacavir upon the patient's discharge.
